rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that applies only if a condition is met.

example.english: This offer is conditional—you can only use it after spending the specified amount.
example.traditional: 呢個優惠係有條件嘅，要買滿指定金額先用得。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau1 wai6 hai6 jau5 tiu4 gin2 ge3 jiu3 maai5 mun5 zi2 ding6 gam1 ngaak6 sin1 jung6 dak1

rows.note: Use this technical term when “conditional” describes an if-then sentence or statement.

example.english: The teacher said that “if it rains, the match will be postponed” is a conditional.
example.traditional: 老師話「如果落雨，場波就要延期」係條件句。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 waa6 jyu4 gwo2 lok6 jyu5 coeng4 bo1 zau6 jiu3 jin4 kei4 hai6 tiu4 gin2 geoi3
